{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] '''''Merisee Hope''''' was a known [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]-runner for one of the brothels on the edge of [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Invisec]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The ''[[Pulsar Skate]]'' later used that ship's name as an alias during the insertion of several [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] members into Coruscant.
